title: Ski Day Vertical Drop vs Lift Time
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:activity sport=ski
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(vertical_drop_m) as vertical_drop_m, sum(lift_time_min) as lift_time_min by athlete resort _time
| where vertical_drop_m>0
| sort - vertical_drop_m
description: Uses Garmin ski activity exports telemetry to monitor how much vertical each ski day produced relative to lift time in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for resort days with poor lift efficiency or standout volume, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Garmin ski activity exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Daily resort chart of vertical drop beside lift minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how much vertical each ski day produced relative to lift time so you can spot resort days with poor lift efficiency or standout volume before it becomes annoying.
